paragraphs.source_en: You go, and I will go too; here we part. Take whichever broad road you choose and go with a calm heart. See, the streetlights stretch all the way to the edge of the sky—just follow that line of light. You go first. I stand here and watch you go, stepping lightly so the dusty earth will not rise. I want to recognize your departing figure clearly until the distance makes you grow uncertain. If not, I will call out your name again and again to remind you that I am here, to ease the loneliness of this desolate street and deep night as I see you off. No—my mind is enough for itself. You need not worry about me. You take the main road; I will enter this narrow lane. See that tree, touching the sky. I walk on until I turn past it. Beyond that is a stretch of wild, tangle-like open land: deep pools and shallow basins, half-lit still waters, like scattered tears in the night shimmer. There are stones, and hooked vines with thorns that can catch the ankle, waiting to trip passersby when they grow careless. But do not worry for me. I have courage enough; no perilous road can make my heart grow cold. When you are well gone, I will step forward in a great stride. This wilderness has plenty of the cool freshness of night dew. I do not fret about deep clouds that wrap around me either; if the wind moves, then in the sea of clouds the stars and constellations will heave up in flowing waves like liquid silver. Besides, all the way to the bottom of my heart there is always a pearl of unending light—you who never fade by night. I love you.

paragraphs.source_zh:
你去，我也走，我们在此分手；

你上哪一条大路，你放心走，

你看那街灯一直亮到天边，

你只消跟从这光明的直线！

你先走，我站在此地望着你，

放轻些脚步，别叫灰土扬起，

我要认清你的远去的身影，

直到距离使我认你不分明。

再不然我就叫响你的名字，

不断的提醒你有我在这里，

为消解荒街与深晚的荒凉，

目送你归去……

不，我自有主张，

你不必为我忧虑；你走大路，

我进这条小巷，你看那棵树，

高抵着天，我走到那边转弯，

再过去是一片荒野的凝乱：

有深潭，有浅洼，半亮者止水，

在夜芒中像是纷彼的眼泪；

有石块，有钩刺胫踝的蔓草，

在期待过路人疏神时绊倒！

但你不必焦心，我有的是胆，

凶险的途程不能使我心寒。

等你走远了，我就大步向前，

这荒野有的是夜露的清鲜；

也不愁愁云深裹，但须风动，

云海里便波涌星斗的流汞；

更何况永远照彻我的心底，

有那颗不夜的明珠，我爱你！
